identification: Several hundred dug Tasmanian/Australian bottles in about 10 boxes and a crate. Photos show: H. JONES & CO IXL HOBART & SYDNEY crown seal soda (amethyst, photo 8, embossing legible); 5 cobalt bottles (4 tall, 1 square aqua-ish, photo 2); about 10 salt-glaze/Bristol stoneware inks and blacking bottles (photo 5); a large green hand-blown bulbous bottle and black glass bottles (photos 4, 12); many aqua inks, chemist and medicine bottles (photos 3, 11, 13, 14); a Fanta soda bottle and a Crown/other amethyst soda (photos 9, 10). Mostly common, dirty, dug condition.
